capabilities: Pull mentioned X posts and threads into the vault as Markdown notes
Sync saved posts manually or on a 5-60 minute interval
Customize file names, frontmatter, and note templates with Mustache syntax
Choose a destination folder for saved notes
Optionally delete posts from the service after they are written
disambiguation: The plugin itself does not fetch posts directly; it only syncs notes prepared by the Save2Obsidian service after you mention @save2obsidian on X.
extras: The README states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the external service is api.save2obsidian.com and no pricing is mentioned. It does not download remote images or attachments from saved posts.
problem: Saving X posts and threads as Markdown notes requires manual copy-paste or screenshots; Obsidian has no built-in way to capture them.
summary: X-to-vault saver that pulls posts and threads mentioned to @save2obsidian into your vault as clean Markdown notes.
